title: Travel and Holidays
summary: Travel planning, destinations, preferences, and holiday experiences.
whyItMatters: Travel planning combines destination, transport, accommodation, budget, activities, weather, and personal priorities.

mentalModel.title: Build a travel profile
mentalModel.content: Name when, where, how, with whom, for how long, and at what budget.

mentalModel.title: Separate needs from wishes
mentalModel.content: Mark what is necessary, what is preferred, and what would simply be nice.

ruleBlocks.title: Cover the practical categories
ruleBlocks.content: Include booking, documents, luggage, transport, accommodation, meals, and local mobility.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe a destination specifically
ruleBlocks.content: Use landscape, climate, distance, atmosphere, and available activities.

ruleBlocks.title: Evaluate an experience with evidence
ruleBlocks.content: Say what was relaxing, surprising, difficult, or worthwhile and explain why.

examples.de: Im Sommer möchten wir eine Woche an die Nordsee fahren.
examples.en: In summer we would like to go to the North Sea for a week.

examples.de: Wir suchen eine ruhige Unterkunft in der Nähe vom Strand.
examples.en: We are looking for quiet accommodation near the beach.

examples.de: Die Reise war anstrengend, aber die Landschaft war wunderschön.
examples.en: The journey was tiring, but the landscape was beautiful.

commonMistakes.reason: Countries with an article use in plus accusative for destination.

commonMistakes.wrong: Choose a trip without naming constraints.
commonMistakes.correct: Include dates, budget, mobility, and essential needs.

comparisons.summary: Hätte and wäre gern express imagined travel wishes politely.
The communication lesson compares and negotiates travel priorities.
